No backend code changed and no new backend regressions. Frontend bundles cleanly on SDK 57 (expo@57 in supervisor logs, 'Web Bundled 6095ms' with 1416 modules, 0 page errors on load). BLE service file still exports TARGET_DEVICE_NAME='TERESA01', TERESA_SERVICE_UUID='7b4c0001-7f9d-4a2e-9d7c-6f3e2a1b0001', TERESA_TELEMETRY_CHAR / TERESA_COMMAND_CHAR, and parseTeresaTelemetry at the expected lines. Only benign RN-Web deprecation warnings carried over from iter-4 (shadow*, pointerEvents, useNativeDriver). No SDK-57 regression detected.

react_native_issues.issue: Carry-over from iter-4 — console warnings '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow"' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Non-fatal, web-only. Not introduced by SDK 57 upgrade.
Carry-over — 'Animated: useNativeDriver is not supported because the native animated module is missing. Falling back to JS-based animation.' Web preview only; native build will not warn.

action_items: No SDK-57 regressions found. Upgrade is safe to ship.

Known pre-existing (not a regression): Settings → 'Exportar relatório' on the WEB preview surfaces a 'Falha ao gerar relatório' toast because expo-print's printToFileAsync is iOS/Android-only. The button itself is tappable and the handler catches the error cleanly — same behavior as SDK 54. If PDF export on web is desired, use Print.printAsync (opens browser print dialog) when Platform.OS === 'web', otherwise keep printToFileAsync for native builds. /app/frontend/app/(app)/settings.tsx:51.
Optional cosmetic (carry-over): migrate 'shadow*' / props.pointerEvents / useNativeDriver=true usages behind Platform.OS !== 'web' to silence RN-Web deprecation warnings.
